messages:
Anita_CS: FYI customer 'BrightRetail' reporting a spike of 502/504s hitting hosted inference in us-west-2 since ~04:12 UTC. Lots of auth retries and long tail latency. Seeing support ticket and they attached curl + logs. :warning:
Mike_SRE: On it. Can you paste the top-level error patterns and a sample request id?
Anita_CS: request ids: rQ7a2f, rQ7a3b, rQ7a5c. Errors look like: "gateway timeout (504)" and mixed 502s with backend reset. They also reported massive reconnects in their client.
Sara_Dev: quick repro I ran from office: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/inference/us-west-2/model-x/generate
```
Response headers show upstream-reset and long TTFB ~1.3s then 502.
NetOps: I see BGP flaps with provider-3 for the us-west-2 interconnect between 04:09 and 04:22 UTC. Multiple withdraws and AS path changes. Packet loss spikes on egress toward provider-3 at .15-.25% on measurements.
Mike_SRE: Can you paste the bgp event IDs / traceroute? We need to confirm path change correlates with the errors.
NetOps: traceroute sample (shortened):
```
traceroute to provider-3 (198.51.100.23), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.2 ms  0.2 ms  0.2 ms
 6  198.51.100.1  12.4 ms  20.3 ms  120.5 ms  <-- interconnect queuebloat/htb
 7  198.51.100.23  120.6 ms  121.0 ms  122.4 ms
```
packet loss: 0/100 -> 12/100 during the window.
Anita_CS: Customer also attached tcpdump showing retransmits and duplicate acks.
Tom_Eng: Could be bufferbloat on provider egress or MTU fragmentation causing segmentation and resets. Any sign of MTU mismatches?
NetOps: MTU looks consistent end-to-end, but we saw a transient mismatch on one of provider routers while it re-synced, causing fragmentation and some drops. We've opened with provider-3 NOC, they're escalating.
Mike_SRE: Mitigation steps: 1) add a temporary routing policy to prefer provider-1 and provider-2 for us-west-2 egress (if capacity allows) 2) enable retry-budget on the gateway proxy to avoid thundering retries 3) enable short-circuit fallback to model-x-small for hosted inference when we detect 5xx spike. Can infra execute 1 & 2 now?
NetOps: Pushing BGP prepend/route preference to shift ~60% of traffic to provider-1/provider-2 now. Will monitor.
DeployBot: Route preference change applied at 04:34 UTC to edge routers.
Sara_Dev: For CS ingestion: repro steps for support to run: 1) curl with -v 2) capture full response headers 3) if 502 attach request id and hop IPs 4) run mtr to provider-3 and capture 60s window. Add sample command provided.
BillingBot: Note: customer reported increased resource usage due to client-side aggressive retries—they saw ~3x token charges over the window. We should offer to credit the excess until we stabilize.
Anita_CS: I told customer were investigating, offered temporary credit and suggested disabling client retries for 10m. They asked for ETA.
Mike_SRE: ETA: If reroute holds, expect error rate to drop within 10-20m; if provider fixes are needed it may be longer. I'll keep thread updated.
Tom_Eng: Also rolling a lightweight change to gateway to throttle retries from same client IP for 5 minutes as immediate mitigation (hotfix).
NetOps: Observability: packet loss on provider-3 is down to 1.2% after route preference change. Latency tails are improving but still above baseline.
Mike_SRE: Confirmed 502 spike dropped 80% in the last 5m. Still monitoring.
Anita_CS: Customer on call and accepting temporary credits. I'll follow up with a postmortem once stabilized. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
